subject.title: fix: require admin for keyed session model changes [AI]

question: Should a write-scoped operator retain the documented ability to create a fresh explicitly keyed session with an initial model or thinking level, while admin scope is required only when that key resolves to an existing session?
rationale: The proposed parameter-only gate is secure for existing-session reconfiguration but changes the established create contract for fresh named sessions; that user-facing scope boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Gate only existing-key adoption
options.body: Preserve write-scoped fresh keyed-session creation and enforce admin after resolving that the supplied key already maps to an existing session with model or thinking changes.

options.title: Adopt a broad admin policy
options.body: Require admin for every explicitly keyed model or thinking request and document this deliberate compatibility break for all write-scoped integrations.

recommendation.title: Gate only existing-key adoption
recommendation.body: Preserve write-scoped fresh keyed-session creation and enforce admin after resolving that the supplied key already maps to an existing session with model or thinking changes.
